purpose: Descriptive interpretation of previously acquired source arrays; not predictive feature selection
input_contract: Published numeric NPZ hashes and grid; uint8 heights in metres; valid zero; nodata 255; common valid Ontario footprint across all seven epochs
metrics: All-value and conditional positive-value means and p10/p50/p90
Fraction strictly above displayed 30m colour ceiling
Consecutive-epoch same/decreased/increased proportions and mean absolute change
Exact symmetric decomposition of end-point mean change into positive-share and positive-height-mean terms
figure: Fixed 0..40m endpoint histogram; disclose mass beyond displayed extent. All seven all-value and conditional positive means, fixed 0..20m axis.
checks: NPZ hashes and grid identical to published parents
Histogram totals and weighted means agree with existing extraction receipt
Zero counts agree with existing extraction receipt
Direct-array moments and transition counts agree with histogram summary
Endpoint decomposition recomposes mean change to numerical tolerance
limitations: Positive height is not a forest-cover label or a tree-density measure
480m NEAREST overview is not native 30m area-weighted sampling
Full-series retrospective processing and common seven-epoch mask do not establish as-of availability
Descriptive source variation establishes no predictive improvement; no outcome data is read
